title: Scenic Routes of Bali | Culture, Coastlines, Cascades
highlights: Begin your Bali escape with a romantic stay in a beautifully decorated room, setting the perfect mood for a relaxing and love-filled holiday.
Walk the Tegallalang Rice Terraces, where lush green steps showcase Bali’s farming tradition and offer breathtaking views of the countryside.
Enjoy a journey through Bali’s lush countryside in a vintage Volkswagen car, where retro charm blends with panoramic views and timeless island beauty.
Indulge in handpicked Balinese spas, offering authentic therapies and serene settings — all with exclusive savings of up to 50% for a truly rejuvenating escape.
Delight in authentic Indian flavours at renowned Bali restaurants, using food vouchers that let you savor every meal with 30% off.
Enjoy free access to Tropical Temptation, Bali’s stylish beach club, offering stunning views, vibrant energy, and unforgettable coastal experiences.
overview:
About the Tour:
Begin your Bali getaway at Tegenungan Waterfall, glide high on the Bali Swing, and explore the lush Tegallalang Rice Terraces. Continue to visit the holy waters of Tirta Empul before heading to scenic Handara Gate and the serene Ulun Danu Beratan Temple. Also, wander through Bali Botanical Garden and rev up for an exciting Jungle ATV Ride. Sail to Nusa Penida to admire Kelingking Beach, Angel’s Billabong, Broken Bay, and snorkel in Crystal Bay. Unwind with a floating breakfast and Balinese massage in Kuta. Enjoy a romantic candlelight dinner, then end your trip with a sunset visit to Uluwatu Temple and the spellbinding Kecak Dance show.

know_before_you_go: Visa on Arrival (VOA) for Indonesia is not included in your package and must be obtained and paid for at the airport upon your arrival. Please ensure you have the necessary documents ready.
Complimentary activities included in your package are provided as a value addition, but if any of these are missed for any reason, they cannot be refunded, exchanged, or compensated.

Where your itinerary mentions “local lunch,” it refers to an authentic Balinese meal featuring traditional flavors and dishes. Indian food will not be served during these local lunch experiences unless specifically mentioned.
Vehicles will follow a fixed point-to-point route as per the itinerary. Any changes or additional sightseeing requests may incur extra charges.
Bahasa Indonesia is the official language, and Balinese is also widely spoken. However, English is commonly understood in most tourist areas.
The local currency is the Indonesian Rupiah (IDR). While credit cards are accepted in many restaurants and hotels, cash is often preferred in smaller shops and markets.
When visiting temples or sacred sites, dress respectfully: cover your shoulders and knees, and wear a sarong and sash when required (often available at the entrance).

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Bali | Transfer  to Ubud | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Welcome to Bali! Upon arrival at Ngurah Rai Airport, board your transfer to Ubud and check in to your hotel. Then, spend the rest of the day at leisure, where you can relax in the serene surroundings of your hotel or step out to explore the city on your own. You can visit Goa Gajah, the mystical ‘Elephant Cave’ with sacred carvings or wander through Bali Bird Park to encounter exotic species. Also, you can head to Waterbom Bali, Asia’s top-rated waterpark with thrilling slides and lush gardens.

days.title: Floating Breakfast Experience | Bali Jungle Swing | Visit to Tirta Empul Temple | ATV Ride Experience | Visit to Omma Day Club
days.desc: Begin your day with a floating breakfast, a unique indulgence amidst Ubud’s serenity. Then, board your transfer and get driven to the Bali Swing. Once there, soar high above emerald valleys & enjoy stunning views. Next, visit Tirta Empul Temple, famed for its sacred spring pools. Later, gear up for a thrilling ATV ride, navigating the rugged trails and rice paddies. Afterwards, get dropped off at the Omma Day Club, where infinity pools overlook Tegenungan Waterfall, offering the perfect escape.

days.title: Transfer to Nusa Penida | East Nusa Penida Tour | Visit to Cactus Nusa Penida
days.desc: Post check-out, get driven to the Sanur Port and board a speed boat to Nusa Penida. Once there, get driven to the hotel & check in. Later, embark on an East Nusa Penida adventure starting at Diamond Beach, famed for its cliffside stairs. Continue to Atuh Beach, surrounded by dramatic rock formations. Also, admire sweeping views from Thousand Island Viewpoint & visit Rumah Pohon Tree House, a famous photo spot. Later, get dropped off at the Cactus Nusa Penida, your stylish retreat for the night.

days.title: Snorkeling with Manta Rays
days.desc: Today, set out for an unforgettable marine adventure as you get driven to Toyah Pakeh Harbour. From here, embark on your 3-spot snorkeling tour, exploring the vibrant underwater world of Crystal Bay, famed for its clear waters & rich marine life, and Manta Bay, where the thrill of swimming alongside graceful manta rays awaits. This day promises a perfect blend of adventure, natural beauty, & awe-inspiring encounters beneath the waves. Later, get driven back to the hotel from Toyah Pakeh Harbour.

items.title: 3 Spots Snorkeling Tour with Manta Rays

days.title: Transfer Gili Trawang | Gili Islands Sunset Boat Tour & Snorkeling
days.desc: This morning, check out of your hotel & board the transfer from Nusa Penida to Gili Trawangan, a tropical paradise known for its white sandy beaches. Once there, check in to your hotel & relax for a while. Later, get driven to Sama sama Bar and head to the harbour. Once there, board the boat for the Gili Islands Sunset Tour. Sail across turquoise waters, stop for snorkelling at vibrant coral reefs, and watch the sky turn golden over the ocean. Afterwards, get driven to the hotel.

items.title: Gili Islands Sunset Boat Tour and Snorkeling
Gili Islands Sunset Boat Tour and Snorkeling

days.title: Leisure Time in Gili Trawangan | Visit to Malibu Day Club
days.desc: Spend your morning at leisure, relaxing in your resort or exploring the island at your own pace. You can also indulge in thrilling water activities like diving or a glass-bottom boat ride. Later, get driven to Malibu Day Club, a trendy oceanfront venue where infinity pools, chic cabanas, and stunning views create the perfect spot to unwind. Also, you can savour signature cocktails, lounge by the pool, or catch the golden sunset over the sea. Soak in its lively beats and stunning vibes.

days.title: Transfer to Canggu | Sunset Uluwatu Temple  Tour | Balinese Massage in Canggu
days.desc: Today, check out of your resort and travel back to Bali’s mainland, Canggu. En route, get driven to visit the Uluwatu Temple, perched dramatically on cliffs above the ocean. Also, get a chance to witness the Kecak Dance Show. Later, get driven to unwind with a Balinese massage in Canggu, renowned for its healing strokes and aromatic oils. After a relaxing session, continue your journey to your hotel. Upon your arrival, check in and enjoy your overnight stay.

items.title: Day Trip to Uluwatu Temple - Uluwatu Temple Sunset Tour
Balinese Massage in Bali - 1-Hour Balinese Massage in Canggu
Check-in at Sense Canggu Beach Hotel

days.title: Visit to Melasti & Pandawa Beach | Visit to Tropical Temptation
days.desc: Today, explore the stunning beaches of Bali, starting at Melasti Beach, where white sands and towering cliffs create one of Bali’s most dramatic landscapes. Next, visit the Pandawa Beach, a once-hidden treasure now known for calm waters and scenic charm, perfect for swimming or sunbathing. Later, get transferred to Tropical Temptation Beach Club, where infinity pools, cabanas, and ocean views await. After spending an amazing time, return to your hotel on your own.

items.title: Trip to Melasti Beach & Pandawa Beach
Take a dip in their multiple pool zones

days.title: Leisure Time in Canggu
days.desc: Spend a leisurely day where you can explore Canggu on your own. You can visit the Batu Bolong Beach, famous for its volcanic black sand, trendy cafes, and surfer-friendly waves. Also, you can visit the iconic Tanah Lot Temple, perched dramatically on a rocky outcrop in the sea, offering one of Bali’s most spectacular sunset views. Or, relax at Canggu Beach, a hotspot for surfers and beach lovers alike, where golden sands, vibrant beach clubs, & laid-back vibes creates an amazing escape.

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: In the morning, get ready and check out of your hotel in Canggu. Then, board your transfer and get driven to the airport for your flight back home, marking the end of your amazing trip!
